headline: Anthropic blocks Claude Code from cloning video games
body: Anthropic revised its system prompt to stop Claude Code from copying existing video games. Users can still build games with the tool, despite restrictions on recreations.

Anthropic blocks Claude Code from cloning video games

Anthropic revised its system prompt to stop Claude Code from copying existing video games. Users can still build games with the tool, despite restrictions on recreations.
